answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 35051 Country: India Title: One wife asked for Khula and her husband granted khula Question: One wife asked for Khula and her husband granted khula. Now what is the period of iddah? Is it right to claim life long maintenance by the wife from the husband in view of Shariah? Indian courts support life time maintenance and male are suffering a lot. So what is the remedy for this problem? Please kindly reply. Answer ID: 35051 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1677/1677/M=1432) Iddah is three months (three menstruating period) and if at the time of khula the woman is pregnant then her term of iddah is to give birth to her child. After completing iddah, husband is not responsible for any expense. It is not right to demand for a long term expense as per the Shariah. People invite problems by going to courts and then ask its solution from us. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
